moments.title: Premier League 26/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off this Friday, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / The Standard

angles.name: Opening Match Excitement
angles.copy: It's almost here! The Premier League season kicks off this Friday with Arsenal taking on newly-promoted Coventry. Who's ready for the drama? #PremierLeague

angles.name: New Season, New Hope
angles.copy: After a long wait, Premier League football is BACK this Friday! Three new teams are in the mix – Hull City, Coventry, and Ipswich. What are your predictions for the opening weekend?

angles.name: Local Team Interest
angles.copy: The new Premier League season starts this Friday! With Hull City, Coventry, and Ipswich Town all promoted, which game are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Arsenal Win Community Shield
moments.blurb: Arsenal lifted the Community Shield trophy on Sunday, beating Manchester City 3-0 in a dominant performance at Principality Stadium.

angles.name: Early Season Statement
angles.copy: A huge statement from Arsenal on Sunday, beating Manchester City 3-0 to win the Community Shield! Does this set them up for a strong Premier League campaign?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Cardiff's Principality Stadium hosted the Community Shield on Sunday, seeing Arsenal beat Man City 3-0! What a start to the football season in Wales.

moments.title: UK Weather: Warm South, Wet North
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing a mixed bag of weather this week, with warmer, drier conditions expected in the south and south-east, while northern and western areas see more cloud and showers, some potentially heavy.

angles.name: Sunshine vs Showers
angles.copy: Sun's out in the South-East, but don't forget your brolly if you're further North or West! Typical August, keeping us on our toes.

angles.name: Devon Forecast
angles.copy: Devon, get ready for a mix this week! While the south of the UK sees more warmth, we might catch some of those showers. Fingers crossed for more sunshine!
